// CASE ts_fn_formatted expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
  items: readonly T[],
  step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
  options: { readonly reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE ts_steps_formatted expect=pass
export async function inOrderSteps(
  steps: ReadonlyArray<() => Promise<void>>,
  options: { readonly reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}
// CASE ts_overloads expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: Opts): Promise<void>;
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: Opts): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
